ratings.comment: He is the sweetest professor. Likes having a conversation with his students. Attend his lectures and you'll easily pass the class.

Craciun is a nice person, a meh lecturer, but most calc222 profs are. The second half of semester, which has the harder concepts, was made more difficult by his lack of organization and heavy reliance on the textbook, and we ended up doing homework on concepts we hadn't learned yet because he hadn't got to them in lecture. Has nice colored chalk.

Georghe is a good guy, and he really really knows his stuff. The only problem is that he sometimes goes on ramblings during lecture. However, if you sit near a spot where you can hear him well and won't be distracted you will get a lot out of his lectures. When you approach a midterm he'll make sure to take class time and review important concepts.

Don't get me wrong, he's a great guy with a good sense of humor, but his lectures were the worst I've ever been to. He rambles, making it difficult to actually get anything important from the lecture. Some days he just put up the textbook and scrolled before you could write anything down. Learned everything from my TA. Never taking his class again.

He makes this course so much more difficult than it needs to be. He started off really well, but switched teaching styles to reading straight from the book. He wastes time explaining irrelevant topics. He is clearly intelligent, just not good at teaching this course.
Hes a good guy but fails to teach the stuff we actually need to know and spends too much time talking about irrelevant topics or obvious stuff.

Some people really didn't like him, but I don't see why. Was pretty clear when explaining the concepts, and was reasonably engaging. The only criticism I have is that the class went through a lot of the harder stuff at the end kind of fast.

Gheorghe was a decent professor. He definitely knew the material, but it was a little hard to learn it from him in lectures, due to both volume and the way he talked the problems through. He did make some math jokes however.

Seems super nice, he made cute little jokes throughout lecture. His focus did seem a bit sporadic and he was kinda mean about people coming in late... I honestly skipped his lectures and still somehow got out okay
Seems like a nice guy but lectures are very unfocused and not helpful at all. I learned a lot more from my TA and relied on previous calculus knowledge

Professor Craciun is amazing for graduate level learners, but when it comes to undergrads, he fails miserably. Dragging out a subject for two days that can be solved in 10 minutes, and making one mistake after the next. Good man, but a bad teacher.
Very unfocused and sporadic lectures

Amazing choice for both senior math major/ grad student and for the people from other department as well. Professor covers few materials very well, introduce you to the idea and motivation behind mathematical object and concept that you will hear nowhere else.  The tool you get will help you with any other math classes that you encounter later.

Fantastic professor. I absolutely love his lecture. It turns many factsformulas that we blindly memorized into something so clear and easy to understand. It just makes so much sense! Also, he is SUPER nice, and really cares about students to succeed. Although he has some accent, but it can be totally overlooked, comparing to his great teaching.
Math 703 is an interesting course,  and he makes it even easier.
Teaches straight out of the book, not very helpful.  Midterms are easy but the final is more difficult.

He loves his colored chalk...  I learned a lot from him, and it usually wasn't hard to understand, but he gave my class the impression that he didn't really want to be there, especially because he was always a little late, but he told us not to come if we were going to be late

Awesome guy! Likes to make cute, little jokes every now and then which helps when the lecture is at 8:50am. His grading and exams are very fair. He explains concepts in its simplest terms instead of over complicating them. Just don't talk during lecture. He'll call you out on that.

Awesome guy, got a standing ovation from the class multiple times-- not joking. Teaches well and is very clear on how mostly every works. Keep in mind it is Calc III, it's not the easiest course in the world, but if you are going to take it, take it w/ craciun!
I learned a lot, and also, he can be really funny at times.  As long as you pay attention, the exams should be pretty easy.
Ugh, he went so slowwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwww

I have never taken calculus before and found this class to be pretty good. I went into it thinking calculus was going to be hard as ever, but Craciun did a really good job explaining concepts and really took the time necessary to explain things. I believe earlier ratings might be a bit our of date, because I felt as if he was a very good teacher.

Slow lectures, midterms are not too bad. I got around 80-86 on both of them. The final seems IMPOSSIBLE when you take it, (I know I did), but I ended up with an A in the class. You may not think you are doing very well, but with the curve you be fine.

Overall a pretty good class. The midterms were relatively easy but the final is much much different. It is cumulative and the questions are much more difficult/advanced than the questions from the midterms. He seems like a cool guy and does many things to try to help ur grade - too much I'd say. If you do the homework, and understand it, you will a

DO NOT take this proffessor if you did not take calc is hs otherwise your first calc experience will be a bad one.  if you took calc in hs the class overall wasnt that bad - 2 midterms and a final.  final is really hard but is curved cause everyone does worse then on their midterms.  one quiz every week i got an AB very happy with it

Georghe...what a character.  The power lectures were brutal to get through.  However, he actually did a good job at preparing you for the midterms, which were very manageable, but the final may as well have been written in Arabic.  He enjoys informing you of how little you actually know about math on the final.

Funny guy, very neat notes. Whether they teach you much is debateable. Midterms were easy, there is a lot of homework and you have to do it so the book is a must. Final was unbelievably difficult- If I had the choice I would NOT take the class again, but Craciun was the man (minus the being good at teaching part)

Interesting character. Class is slow and rather pointless. Taught myself mostly out of the book. Mid terms were easy but final was obscenely difficult, not even comparable to mid terms and ruined the A i had going into the final. furious.
Do not take Georghe if you can help it. He is a very nice guy but is lacking in the attributes that are needed for students to learn...

Explains the easy stuff, but not a lot of the harder material. On the midterms there is a mix of easy questions and hard, but they are not too bad. The final however, is ridiculous. Consists entirely of difficult questions, many word problems. He says it is cumulative + takes problems from homework, but evidently he chooses the hardest ones. Bad

intelligent guy, but a terrible professor. Makes many mistakes in class on the board when explaining material, and his tests are real difficult b/c of all the word problems that seek more then just the calc that you learn. TA's are worthless b/c they don't speak any english.

If you can do not take him as your calc professor.  His lectures suck, they are so slow and he does a horrible job explaining the information. If you must take him pray that you have a good TA that can help you through.  Exams are very hard if you have not taken calc before.

DO NOT take craciun if you've never had calc before. lecture was slow and pointless. he spent more time drawing pictures w/ his colored chalk than he did lecturing. what he did teach NEVER corresponded to the homework. midterms were nearly impossible for someone like me who's never had calc before. on the plus side, he was funny at times...

WORST teacher ever...lectures are SLOW and pointless, the tests aren't too challenging but the final was rediculous and screwed over everyone's grade, the average was 50%....Don't take him if you can help it

He lectures very slowly, and in a very disorganized fashion.  His tests are easy, with 90% of the questions from the homework, which isn't very much at all.  Beware of the final!  He allowed us a formula sheet and to compensate he made the final impossible.
Very very very confusing...didn't enjoy this class at all.

one of the worst teachers for someone who hasn't taken calc before!!!!!!  he doesn't teach - he mumbles and pronounces area "ayia".  very slow lectureer = sleep each lecture seriously.  exams were so-so most from hw. final was hard! worthless teacher tho - i learned all from book and disc - DON'T TAKE THIS MAN IF YOU HAVEN"T ALREADY TAKEN CALC!!
he is extremely slow with lecture and often pointless. most times there is no need to go to lecture, just get a decent TA and you'll be fine. his tests aren't bad either.

Exams are easy, 90% of the questions are copied directly from the homework.  He often doesn't finish lecturing on topics that he had originally planned to lecture on, not covering all the calculus concepts that you might need for 222.  Otherwise, he is a very cool guy with EXTREMELY funny mannerisms.

The lecture is slow paced and he definitely explains the easy material as well as the irrelevant material in depth but not as much the more difficult stuff. Having taken calc in high school lecture is pretty worthless but his tests are easy and he assigns about half the homework problems as most of the other calc 221 professors.

Craciun works up a sweat while writing on the board...though he doesn't get through much in lecture.  He likes to spend TONS of time on insignificant details, and very little time on important points...BUT his tests are easy.  Do the homework and you'll do just fine
He talks quietly and with a slight accent, but its not too hard to understand him.  Kinda picky on tests, if you know how to do the homework, you know how to do the test.
Goes insanely slow in his lectures, so if that's good for you, take him! His exams are based off of the homework so if you do the homework you'll get an average grade.
